description.zh: 光标到达屏幕外边时从对边进入（多显示器边缘拓扑，支持仅纵向/仅横向与按住 Ctrl/Shift 激活）；cursorwrap 关键字查看状态与开关
description.en: The cursor re-enters from the opposite edge when it reaches an outer edge (multi-monitor edge topology; vertical/horizontal-only modes and Ctrl/Shift activation); the cursorwrap keyword shows status and toggles it

hint.zh: 留空列出设置；也可输 tune / best / trace
hint.en: empty lists the settings; try tune / best / trace

ai.description: Show the cursor-wrap settings list: enabled state, impact mode and speed gate, wrap mode, activation, monitor count and outer-edge count, plus entries for the tuning overlay and the arrival trace. Read-only; nothing changes until a row's action runs.

hint.zh: both：四个方向；vertical：仅上/下；horizontal：仅左/右
hint.en: both: all four; vertical: top/bottom only; horizontal: left/right only

hint.zh: always 立即生效；ctrl / shift 需按住该键才回绕（Ctrl 单独滚轮留给任务栏音量插件，本插件只看移动）
hint.en: always wraps immediately; ctrl / shift wrap only while the key is held (plain Ctrl stays with the taskbar volume plugin — this plugin only watches movement)

hint.zh: 按住左键拖动窗口或选区时禁用，防止把窗口甩到对角
hint.en: disables wrapping while the left button is held, so dragged windows stay put

hint.zh: 只接一块屏时也回绕到本屏对边（PowerToys 默认行为）；不想这样可关掉
hint.en: on one display the cursor still wraps to the same display's opposite edge (PowerToys default); turn off to disable that

hint.zh: 1–20，默认 1；离外边多近才算到了边上
hint.en: 1–20, default 1; how close to an outer edge counts as being on it

hint.zh: 10–200，默认 50；回绕后在这个范围内不再触发，防止来回弹
hint.en: 10–200, default 50; after a wrap, events within this range of the destination do not wrap again

hint.zh: 10–200，默认 50；两条边差多少像素以内算相邻（内边不回绕）
hint.en: 10–200, default 50; edges closer than this count as adjacent (inner edges never wrap)

hint.zh: 开启后光标必须以足够速度撞到边缘才回绕；慢慢挪到边缘（比如去点任务栏）不会触发
hint.en: when on, the cursor must hit the edge fast enough to wrap; drifting to the edge (say, toward the taskbar) does not trigger

hint.zh: 500–20000，默认 2000；按最近一段朝向边缘的连续逼近测速，沿边缘平行滑动不算
hint.en: 500–20000, default 2000; judged over the last continuous stroke toward the edge — sliding along the edge does not count

hint.zh: 50–500，默认 400；只在距边缘该范围内测速——远处冲刺不算，贴边抖动因位移过小也不算。加速度门槛有自己的 2000 px 回溯范围，不受此值限制
hint.en: 50–500, default 400; speed is measured only within this distance of the edge — distant sprints and edge jitter (too little travel) both fail. The acceleration floor reaches back 2000 px on its own and is not limited by this value

title.zh: 撞击加速度门槛（像素/秒²）

hint.zh: 0 = 关闭（只看速度）；开启后必须「加速冲进边缘」才回绕——匀速滑到边缘再快也不回绕，到边缘已经减速的也不回绕。实测：匀速读数恒为 0，正常甩腕约 1600–3600，因此建议 500–2000（默认 500 已能区分，调高更严格）
hint.en: 0 = off (speed only); when on, the hand must be SPEEDING UP into the edge — a constant-speed sweep never wraps however fast, and neither does a hand that has already slowed at the edge. Measured: a steady hand reads 0 and a normal flick reads 1600–3600, so 500–2000 is the usable range (500 already separates them; higher is stricter)

hint.zh: 在能回绕的外边缘画出测速区间与门槛线，并在撞到边缘时显示实测速度；内边不画。与搜索栏的 tune 是同一个开关
hint.en: draws the measuring band and the wrap line on outer edges only, plus the measured speed when you hit one; same switch as tune in the search bar

hint.zh: 打开一个实时数据窗口：到达速度直方图、建议门槛、最近决策日志、按原因分类的跳过计数、钩子健康。不抢焦点，关掉窗口即停
hint.en: opens a live data window: arrival-speed histogram, suggested gate, recent decisions, per-reason skip counts and hook health. Never takes focus; closing the window turns it off
